sources.title: Proteogenomic analysis of chemo-refractory high-grade serous ovarian cancer
sources.locator: Figure 3D; STAR Methods: Patient Selection and Cohorts (S29), FFPE/frozen alignment (S66), Feature Selection (S94), Prediction Model Building and Performance Evaluation (S95-S99); S27 data availability; P135-144 quantification/preprocessing
sources.takeaway: Published 64-protein panel with cohort-specific evaluation. Static audit records endpoint definitions, selected-cohort denominators, validation feature-availability filtering, and 43 alignment pairs including 14 additional same-patient tumor pairs.
sources.limitations: Full manuscript via Europe PMC; publisher/PMC HTML inaccessible. Pinned public supplement eligibility and patient-key joins were subsequently checked (S14); the frozen subgroup labels require reconciliation. No model performance reproduced. Corrected supplement status remains unverified. See S11 and docs/pilot-001-input-resolution.md.

sources.title: Tracking clonal evolution during treatment in ovarian cancer using cell-free DNA
sources.locator: Abstract; evolution of drug resistance; discussion
sources.takeaway: Longitudinal clonal tracking supports selection of pre-existing HGSOC clones during treatment.
sources.limitations: Publisher full text initially readable; later fetch redirected to inaccessible identity service. Abstract cross-checked in Europe PMC. Observational/mechanistic results are not a trial proving improved survival from adaptive therapy.

sources.title: Mapping spatial organization and genetic cell-state regulators to target immune evasion in ovarian cancer
sources.locator: Abstract; spatial mapping; perturbation experiments
sources.takeaway: Spatial and perturbational work links malignant cell states and immune interactions in high-grade serous tubo-ovarian cancer.
sources.limitations: Publisher route inaccessible; full article read via Europe PMC XML. Experimental immune-cell killing does not establish patient survival benefit.

sources.title: Author code: CPTAC Ovarian Chemo Response
sources.locator: Pinned current main; all 42 R/r/Rmd files; 69 reachable upstream commits and 66 distinct complete trees; three public forks; issue #1 and PR #3; Figure_3D_part3.R lines 105-127 and 154-175; preprocessing.R lines 3-22; preprocessing.R 51-165, 263-328; preprocess_markdown.Rmd 42-142
sources.takeaway: Pinned commit 48357fd63ccbfe3954f38c8efc558b4f88bd6051: named pilot inputs/helper absent from its tree; static audit identifies unresolved cohort/object ownership, importance reduction, coefficient indexing, and metric provenance. Repeated-CV discovery scores feed roc.all1, but no score export connects them to the supplement. Column renaming depends on an absent annotation table with an earlier data-label field. Preprocessing review locates label-dependent filtering, temporary KNN/ComBat/missingness restoration, DreamAI and a commented after-imputation replicate-averaging example.
sources.limitations: Read-only static search; no author code executed or redistributed. Missing helper/panel/input workspaces not found in inspected current/history/fork trees or indexed searches; this does not establish global unavailability. Reconstruction remains blocked by source files, transformations, label coding, and corrected supplements. See docs/pilot-001-input-resolution.md. The inspected 42 analysis files contain no supplement score-sheet names or Pred.scores references. The absence of a mapping does not identify the cause of the supplied-score AUROC discrepancy. See docs/pilot-001-independent-progress.md. Paper/code outlier thresholds differ (10^-7 versus 10^-10); object-name mismatches and absent archive/workspace export links prevent establishing executed transformation history. See docs/pilot-001-preprocessing-provenance.md.

sources.title: PDC case, sample and aliquot data model
sources.locator: Case, Sample, Aliquot and pool field definitions; Usage: Case Summary
sources.takeaway: Case relates data to a subject within a project; samples reference cases and aliquots reference samples. Canonical case IDs support observed catalog linkage. Pool may combine cases, samples or aliquots.
sources.limitations: Distinct IDs do not prove biological independence; submitter IDs lack a verified global namespace. Pooled records and prediction-specific exclusions require further source reconciliation.

sources.title: NLM versioned public supplements for PMC10414761.1
sources.locator: NIHMS1918576-supplement-MMC1.xlsx clinical sheets; MMC4.xlsx 64_protein_predictors and four prediction-score sheets; supplement-1.pdf
sources.takeaway: Documented NLM cloud distribution yielded byte/hash-pinned clinical and panel/score workbooks. The exact 64-panel and published score membership can be recovered. Explicit clinical fields reconcile eligibility and reveal a patient-key overlap within the published nonoverlap group.
sources.limitations: Source workbooks inspected only in memory for selected fields; no raw rows or workbooks redistributed. Article terms are CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, distinct from PDC terms. Membership findings do not prove an effect on performance or absence from preprocessing/alignment. Available figure legends are not certified corrected. XML table numbering does not reliably locate workbook contents; use inspected sheet names and hashes. The pinned Figure S3 caption has a demonstrated content mismatch with article-XML references; do not use it as authoritative for those panel assignments. See docs/pilot-001-independent-progress.md. Article-version JSON explicitly associates MMC1/MMC4 with its CC BY-NC-ND metadata; this is not a separate workbook notice. Private noncommercial adaptation versus sharing restrictions are clarified in docs/pilot-001-data-use.md.

All 64 panel symbols occur exactly once among 8800 feature rows.
sources.limitations: Bounded in-memory source inspection under the explicit next-step instruction and author public-download statement, not an archive license grant. Full member decompressed for CRC/hash and annotations; abundance fields discarded without numeric conversion, analysis or retention. Whole archive not hashed; SHA256 is newly observed rather than checked against an independent publisher reference. Exact symbol coverage does not establish biological specificity, original-workspace equivalence or transformation history. Archive-specific license terms remain unverified; do not inherit PDC or Figshare licensing. See docs/pilot-001-independent-progress.md and docs/pilot-001-preprocessing-provenance.md. A targeted 2026-10-25 follow-up located no explicitly licensed byte-identical release. The project selects a conditional Canadian research fair-dealing assessment for a noncommercial phase; actual execution context must support it before analysis. This does not discover an archive license. See docs/pilot-001-data-use.md.

sources.title: Canadian research fair dealing: Copyright Act section 29 and CCH 2004 SCC 13
sources.locator: Copyright Act s.29; CCH paragraphs 50-60 and 70; WIPO judgment record 3721
sources.takeaway: Research is an eligible fair-dealing purpose, followed by a case-specific fairness assessment using purpose, character, amount, alternatives, nature and effect. License availability is not itself determinative of fairness. Supports a conditional narrow research-use assessment for the selected Canadian execution route.
sources.limitations: Does not establish a universal license, automatic fairness, privacy exemption or governing law based on citizenship/server location alone. Direct SCC document retrieval failed; full judgment inspected through official WIPO distribution. Source fingerprints and conditional assessment are in docs/pilot-001-data-use.md.

sources.title: Canadian TCPS 2 scope and public/coded secondary data guidance
sources.locator: Introduction/applicability; scope interpretations 1 and 17; chapter 2 articles 2.2 and 2.4; chapter 5 anonymous/coded information definitions; OPC commercial-activity guidance
sources.takeaway: Applicability follows funding, institutional auspices or adoption rather than citizenship. Publicly available deidentified repository data do not automatically satisfy public-information or anonymous-information exceptions. Assess applicable requirements for the actual independent research context.
sources.limitations: No institutional determination or exemption is asserted. Canadian server location alone does not establish all applicable privacy or contractual obligations. The noncommercial design does not establish exemption from every privacy law. See docs/pilot-001-data-use.md for source URLs and fingerprints.
